snippet.title: Star Wars Arcade - Gameplay - 32X (1994)
snippet.description:
I was doing alright at this game until the Death Star.. Just like Jek Porkins, I guess I should have pulled up...

Star Wars Arcade is a video game released in 1993 to arcades. A home port served as a launch title for the Sega 32X in 1994. It is set during the original Star Wars trilogy.
The game features gameplay similar to that of Atari's Star Wars arcade game from  1983 with players piloting an X-wing or a Y-wing in first or third person perspective and battling Imperial forces.
The game has three levels which include intercepting TIE Fighters in an asteroid field, destroying a Super Star Destroyer and making an assault run on a Death Star. The arcade cabinet allowed two people to play, with one serving as pilot and the other as gunner.
Sega followed up the game's release with the release of Star Wars Trilogy Arcade in 1998.

Developer(s) Sega Interactive/LucasArts
Publisher Sega
Platform(s) Arcade, Sega 32X
Release date(s) 1993 (arcade) 1994 (32X)
